dedupe_keys.name: chesapeake bay vertical land motion gps campaign 2020

description: The Chesapeake Bay GNSS team releases a second GPS survey campaign for vertical land-motion assessment in 2020. Its own Zenodo DOI is public under CC BY 4.0 and lists archived observations and station documentation. Coverage is the Chesapeake Bay region during the 2020 survey. The describing article pairs it with a distinct 2019 deposit to support comparisons across surveys. Those measurements can calibrate subsidence assumptions used in coastal flood exposure studies of roads, drainage or settlements. A caveat is that a year-to-year station difference is sensitive to reference frame and campaign quality; it should not be treated as a reliable long-term trend without the full processing chain. The deposit records observation data, not a ready inundation map or infrastructure impact model. I read the own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading RINEX files, checking site logs or computing velocities. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
